description: Add CredentialDaemonCredentialsProvider, which resolves credentials from a local credential daemon over a Unix domain socket for profiles that set daemon_credential in the shared config file. Compatibility note: the provider requires Java 16 or later on Linux or macOS. On Java 8 to 15 it fails with UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM, and a profile that runs `aws configure export-credentials` as its credential_process can be used instead.
